name: Qattara Depression
text: The Qattara Depression (Arabic: منخفض القطارة, romanized: Munḫafaḍ al-Qaṭṭārah) is a depression in northwestern Egypt, specifically in the Matruh Governorate. The depression is part of the Western Desert of Egypt. The Qattara Depression lies below sea level, and its bottom is covered with salt pans, sand dunes, and salt marshes.

depictions.name: Qattara Depression
depictions.text: The Qattara Depression is a geological depression in the northwest region of Egypt. Aside from Hotep Cavern, the final resting place of the Hidden Ones' co-founders Bayek and Aya, the region bears little points of interest.
